recognize_zh: 雙下肢多發、界限不清的紅褐至紫色皮下結節與斑塊，對稱分布於大腿與小腿，部分表面有結痂與色素沉著，呈多發性脂膜炎樣病灶；此為臨床照，需切片確診。
features: Multiple erythematous to violaceous-brown subcutaneous nodules and plaques
Bilateral, fairly symmetric involvement of thighs and lower legs
Few small crusted or scaly surface lesions; no large ulcers
Gross clinical image without histologic detail
describe_en: Clinical photograph of the lower extremities shows multiple, bilateral, ill-defined erythematous to violaceous-brown subcutaneous nodules and plaques involving the thighs and lower legs, with post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation and a few small crusted surface lesions. No large ulcers are evident. The distribution and appearance are those of a multifocal panniculitis. The image is compatible with subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma but is not diagnostic; deep incisional biopsy including subcutis with immunophenotyping is required.

ddx.vs: Erythema nodosum produces tender pretibial nodules that resolve without ulceration and shows septal panniculitis rather than lobular atypical lymphoid infiltrates.
Lupus profundus favors face, arms and buttocks, heals with lipoatrophy, and histologically shows follicles and plasma cells.
PCGD-TCL tends to produce ulcerated necrotic plaques and is TCR-gamma positive on biopsy.
